significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish both a phenomenon and mechanism: a "low-dimensional, causally manipulable subspace" controls reasoning length, with steering producing smooth length changes and an accuracy-preserving region followed by truncation-related degradation. This is a form-(iii) relation among steering strength, generated tokens, and accuracy, rather than merely the standard form-(ii) steering result; it would constrain expected accuracy-length curves and the choice between latent control and methods such as the budget forcing used in s1 (Muennighoff et al., 2025). The negative branch is also informative because failure of smooth control or of the claimed "wide range" would rule out a generally separable verbosity factor and favor length-correctness entanglement, although it would not settle efficient-reasoning mechanisms beyond verbosity. In the topic-substitution check, efficient mechanistic reasoning alone does not imply this specific response curve or compact causal subspace, so the score is supported by claim-specific content rather than the topic's importance.

reach.justification: The concrete handle is the "training-free, interpretable dial for compute allocation," implemented as a "length-steering vector" whose coefficient is selected before generation, so it is an ex-ante intervention with an action window rather than a post-hoc diagnostic. It could be used by researchers or practitioners to allocate inference compute per query, but the hypothesis does not clearly assert transfer across model families; "test whether a single vector generalizes across tasks and layers" frames broad transfer as an open test rather than part of the conclusion. After re-extraction on a new model, the general prediction of smooth length control and an accuracy-preserving interval may survive, but the claim supplies no cross-model scaling law or threshold that predicts the new model's coefficient or frontier. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this score—the topic alone supplies no inference-time dial—but the unstated model scope and need to rediscover its quantitative behavior keep its reach near the topic median.
